calculation.expression: (close_t / close_{t-20} - 1) - cross_sectional_median_i(close_t / close_{t-20} - 1), lagged one session
calculation.description: Subtract the contemporaneous universe median 20-session return from each instrument's 20-session return, then lag the signal one completed session. Positive values identify assets outperforming the available 15-asset benchmark universe.

validation.regime_notes: 5d IC by regime: 2020-22 +0.02594 (n=1074), 2023-25 -0.01373 (n=1096), 2026 onward +0.02862 (n=681). Strong 10-day aggregate but regime dependence and small cross-section require conservative use.
validation.provenance: All 15 tradable benchmark instruments; daily close data through 2028-05-31; forward returns are evaluated only after the lagged signal date; Spearman cross-sectional IC; dates with at least 8 valid instruments.
